source: Derived from PP13 Qwen/Gemma/Kimi profiles after 2026-06-12 all-13 GPU stress passed; Kimi and DSV4 are intentionally absent.

resident_batch_token_budget.notes: Qwen keeps 262K model context and raises batch target to 128; Gemma is raised to its config-advertised 262K context with batch target 64. Live launch must prove actual KV capacity before production promotion.

gpu_budget.stress_result: 13-node stress reached 96 pct GPU util on every node for 180s, peak raw GPU draw 1191.33 W, hottest node 87 C.

coordinator.notes: Post-92x DSAPI telemetry showed Qwen64+Gemma32 kept average GPU utilization near 15 pct while both queues were full. This first throughput candidate raises sequence admission only; fixed KV bytes and GPU utilization caps stay unchanged until the 128/64 run proves memory headroom.

promotion_gates: Launch Qwen PP12 and Gemma PP12 from pulled main only.
Qwen and Gemma COMPSEC17 pass with >=2048 output token budget.
Run queue saturation at batch 64,128 for Qwen and 32,64 for Gemma while watching memory and power.
